DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 受診後の書類について、お尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about documents after your medical visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場に受診した日の資料を出します。この領収書の目立つ日付が今日なので、今日の受診の証明になると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 職場へ受診資料を出すため領収書の今日の日付が受診証明と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need to submit documentation of the day I saw a doctor to my workplace. Since the prominent date on this receipt is today, I thought it proved that I had a medical visit today.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you need medical-visit documentation for work and thought today's date on the receipt served as proof of a visit today.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 日付の横の見出しを確かめましょう。発行日と、受診や請求の対象となる日が別に書かれていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the heading beside the date. Are the issue date and the date of the visit or billing period written separately?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここに発行日、その下に受診日があります。昨日の受診について今日発行されたので、二つの日付が違うのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発行日と受診日の見出しを読み昨日受診で今日発行と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says issue date here, and visit date below it. It was issued today for yesterday's visit, so the two dates differ.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read the issue-date and visit-date headings and distinguish in Japanese between yesterday's visit and today's issuance.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その違いを会計担当にも確認できます。職場は、受診した日だけでなく休む期間などの記載も求めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can also confirm that distinction with the billing staff. Does your workplace require not only the visit date but also information such as the period you need off work?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 連絡には休んだ期間がわかるものとあります。受診日の領収書だけで休む期間まで示せるとは思わず、必要な書類名を職場に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 職場は休む期間を求め領収書だけで期間を示せるとせず書類名を職場へ聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The message asks for something showing the period I was absent. I will not assume that a receipt for the visit can show the whole period off, and will ask my workplace what document they need.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your workplace wants the period off, so you will not assume a receipt alone shows it and will ask work for the document's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 医師の判断や記載が必要な書類なら、別の申請相談になります。看護師がここで休む期間を証明することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: If the document needs a doctor's judgment or statement, that requires a separate application consultation. A nurse cannot certify the period off work here.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここで期間を決めてもらうつもりではありません。職場の求める期間と書類の種類を確認して、医師や担当窓口へ相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 看護師に休業期間決定を求めず職場要件確認後に医師や担当へ相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am not trying to have the period decided here. I would like to check the period and type of document my workplace requires, then consult a doctor or the relevant desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are not asking the nurse to decide the period off work and want to consult a doctor or the responsible desk after checking workplace requirements.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な内容がわかれば、申請方法と費用、受取時期を担当へ確認できます。今日はどこまで進めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you know the required contents, you can ask the person in charge about the application method, cost, and collection timing. How far would you like to proceed today?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は日付の見方を会計担当に確認し、領収書を保管します。追加書類はまだ申請せず、職場の回答を持って相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は会計へ日付を確認し領収書保管し追加申請は職場回答後と決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I will check how to read the dates with billing staff and keep the receipt. I will not apply for additional documents yet, but will consult after obtaining my workplace's response.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that today you will check the dates with billing and keep the receipt, leaving additional applications until after work replies.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では発行日と受診日の確認として会計へご案内します。書類はお手元にお持ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will direct you to billing to confirm the issue date and visit date. Please keep the documents with you. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転入についてのご相談ですね。どの点から確認しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss moving into the municipality, correct? What shall we check first?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 荷物を運び込んだ日と、私が住み始めた日が違います。申請書の日付にどちらを書くか、自分で決めてよいかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 荷物搬入日と住み始めた日が違い申請日付を自己判断できないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The day I brought my belongings in differs from the day I began living there. I do not know whether I can decide for myself which date to put on the application.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the date belongings were delivered differs from the date you began living there, and ask because you cannot judge the application date yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二つの日の状況を分けて担当へ確認しましょう。荷物を運んだときは、そこに泊まって生活を始めていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us explain the circumstances of the two dates separately and check with the person in charge. When you brought your belongings, had you started staying overnight and living there?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ。その日は荷物だけ置き、前の家へ戻りました。数日後に寝泊まりを始めたので、二つを同じ日として説明したくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最初は荷物だけ置き旧居へ戻り数日後に居住開始したと分けて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. That day I only left my belongings and returned to my previous home. I started staying there a few days later, so I do not want to explain the two as the same day.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain separately in Japanese that you first left only your belongings and returned to your former home, then began living there a few days later.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのご事情を伺って、日付の扱いと期限を担当に確認します。前の住所の役所で受け取った書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will hear those circumstances and check with the person in charge how the dates should be treated and what the deadline is. Do you have documents received from the office at your previous address?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受け取った封筒ごと持っています。在留カードもありますが、これだけで必要なものが全部そろったとは考えず、内容を確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 前役所封筒と在留カードを示し必要物全部と決めず内容確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have them with the envelope I received. I also have my residence card, but I do not assume that these are all the required items; I would like you to check the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the envelope from the previous office and your residence card, and ask in Japanese for the contents to be checked without assuming you have everything required.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人の状況と書類を照合します。健康保険など、転入と関係して別に相談したいこともありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will compare your circumstances with the documents. Is there anything else you would like to discuss separately in connection with the move, such as health insurance?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 勤務先の保険の書類があります。転入すれば保険も同時に全部済むと思わず、必要な手続きがあるか担当先を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 勤務先保険書類があり転入で保険も全部済むとせず必要手続と担当先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have insurance documents from my workplace. I will not assume that moving-in procedures finish all insurance matters at the same time, so please tell me whether any procedures are needed and who handles them.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have workplace insurance documents, do not assume moving-in completes insurance too, and ask about necessary procedures and the responsible contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 住所の相談と保険の確認先を分けてご案内します。申請書の不明な日付は、説明を受けるまで記入を待ちましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will guide you separately for the address consultation and where to check insurance. Please wait to enter the uncertain date on the application until you receive an explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つの日の状況をメモで示し、担当の説明を聞いてから書きます。保険書類も別の用件として出し、今日は何が済んだか最後に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二日付の事情を示し説明後に記入し保険は別用件で完了範囲も確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show notes about the circumstances of the two dates, then fill it in after hearing the explanation. I will present the insurance papers as a separate matter and finally confirm what was completed today.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will explain both dates and fill in the form after guidance, treat insurance separately, and confirm the scope completed.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは日付の相談から担当へつなぎます。まだ転入や保険の完了という段階ではありません。こちらへどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will connect you to the person in charge, starting with the dates. Neither moving-in registration nor insurance is complete at this stage. This way, please. Please excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その上着を着てみて、サイズはいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: How does that jacket fit after trying it on?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今の薄い服の上なら合います。でも仕事では厚い服を下に着るので、今の試着だけで小さい方を買ってよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 薄着で合うが仕事では厚い服を重ねるため小サイズ即購入に迷うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It fits over the thin clothes I am wearing now. But I wear thick clothes underneath at work, so I am unsure whether to buy the smaller size based only on this fitting.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that it fits over thin clothes, but because you layer thick clothes at work you are hesitant to buy the small size immediately.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 重ねる服によって着心地も変わりますね。腕や胸の動きも確認したいところです。厚い服をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The feel changes depending on the clothes underneath. You should also check movement around your arms and chest. Do you have the thick clothes with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日は持っていません。大きい方なら必ずよいとも決めず、下に着る服を持ってもう一度試したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 厚い服は未持参で大きければ必ずよいとせず再試着したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I did not bring them today. I will not assume the larger size must be right either; I would like to bring the clothes I wear underneath and try again.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you did not bring thick clothes and want another fitting without assuming a larger size is necessarily suitable.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 再度の試着をご希望ですね。商品の取り置きについて担当に確認しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You would like to try it on again, then. Shall I ask the person in charge about reserving the item for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 取り置きできるか聞きたいです。できる場合も、期限や連絡方法を聞き、お願いしただけで確保済みとは思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 取り置き可否と期限連絡方法を尋ね希望だけで確保済みとしないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to ask whether it can be held. Even if it can, I will ask about the deadline and contact method, and not assume it has been secured simply because I requested it.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the item can be held and about the deadline and contact method, and say you will not assume a request alone secures it.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 可否と条件を確認します。ご購入後のサイズ交換は、取り置きとは別のご案内になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check availability and conditions. Exchanging sizes after purchase is a separate matter from holding an item.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 交換できるはずだから先に買うのではなく、交換の条件も知りたいです。タグやレシート、使った後かどうかで扱いが違うか確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 交換前提で買わずタグレシート使用状態等の条件も確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Rather than buying first on the assumption I can exchange it, I also want to know the exchange conditions. Please check whether the tags, receipt, and whether it has been used affect how it is handled.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to check conditions such as tags, receipt, and use status, rather than buy on the assumption an exchange is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 購入前の条件確認として伺います。今試した上着は、会計へは進めず戻しておきましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will ask about the conditions before purchase. Shall we put the jacket you just tried back rather than take it to checkout?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今日は買わず、取り置きの回答と交換条件を聞きます。厚い服で試して動きやすさを確認してからサイズを決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は買わず取り置き回答交換条件を聞き厚着試着で動けるサイズを決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not buy today, but will hear the answer about holding it and the exchange conditions. I will decide the size after trying it over thick clothes and checking ease of movement.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not buy today, will ask about holding and exchange conditions, and will decide a size that allows movement after trying it over thick clothes.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 試着品をお戻しします。取り置きはまだ未確定ですので、担当の案内をお待ちください。またお声かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will put the fitting item back. The hold is not confirmed yet, so please wait for the person in charge's guidance. Let us know if you need anything else.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの袋へ入れますか。割れやすい物もありますので、ご希望を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall we use the bag you brought? Some items are fragile, so please tell me your preference.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 持参袋を使います。瓶は自分で立てて入れたいので、会計が済むまでは卵と分けて置いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参袋を使い瓶は自分で立てるので会計まで卵と別置きを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will use my own bag. I want to put the bottles in upright myself, so could you keep them separate from the eggs until checkout is finished?
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will use your own bag and stand the bottles upright yourself, and ask for them to be kept apart from the eggs until payment is finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 瓶と卵は別にしておきます。お支払い方法をお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will keep the bottles and eggs separate. Please choose your payment method.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このカードで払いたいです。端末へ近づけましたが表示が変わらず、もう一度当ててよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: カード決済で表示が変わらずもう一度当ててよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to pay with this card. I held it near the terminal, but the display did not change, so I am unsure whether I should tap it again.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you may tap the card again because the display did not change during card payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 重ねて操作せず、いまの処理状態を確認します。カードは一度離して、こちらの案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Rather than repeat the operation, we will check the current processing status. Please move your card away for now and wait for our instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 繰り返し当てずに待ちます。音を聞いただけで支払い済みとは考えず、完了の表示とレシートを確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 連続操作せず音だけで完了とせず表示とレシートを確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will wait without tapping repeatedly. I will not assume payment is complete just because I heard a sound; I want to check the completion display and receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will avoid repeated operations and want to check the display and receipt rather than assume completion from sound alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が状態を調べます。別の方法で払う場合も、いまの処理を確かめてからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check the status. Even if you pay another way, we will guide you only after checking the current transaction.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 念のため現金も出そうかと思いましたが、二重にならないよう今は出しません。方法を変えるなら、先の処理がどうなったか説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 重複防止のため現金を出さず支払方法変更前に先処理の状態説明を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I thought about getting cash out just in case, but will not do so now to avoid a duplicate payment. If we change methods, please explain what happened to the earlier transaction.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not offer cash to avoid duplicate payment and ask for an explanation of the first transaction's status before changing methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 説明してから次へ進めます。袋詰めも、確認中の品物が他の方のものと混ざらないよう、こちらに分けておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain before proceeding. We will also keep your items being checked separate here so that they do not get mixed up with someone else's while bagging.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私の瓶と卵はここですね。支払状態の説明を待ち、完了を確認してから自分の袋へ入れます。カードも置き忘れないよう手元で確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の瓶卵を確認し支払完了確認後に袋詰めしカード忘れも防ぐと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: My bottles and eggs are here, correct? I will wait for the explanation of the payment status and put them in my bag after confirming completion. I will also check that my card is with me so I do not leave it behind.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check your bottles and eggs, bag them after confirming payment completion, and make sure not to forget your card.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では処理の状態を確認します。まだ完了とはお伝えしていませんので、そのままお待ちください。ご協力ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will check the transaction status. We have not yet said that it is complete, so please continue waiting. Thank you for your cooperation.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内の読み方についてですね。どこでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like help reading the information, correct? Which part is difficult?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 説明会の日は仕事で行けません。欠席なら何もしなくてよいと思いましたが、返信用の紙が入っていて、出す必要があるのか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 勤務で説明会欠席予定だが返信紙があり何もしなくてよいか迷うと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I cannot attend the information session because I work that day. I thought I did not have to do anything if absent, but there is a reply sheet enclosed, so I am unsure whether I need to submit it.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you expect to miss the session because of work but an enclosed reply sheet makes you unsure whether doing nothing is acceptable.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本文には「出欠にかかわらず返信」とあります。この文面なら欠席の連絡も求めています。返信用紙を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The text says to reply regardless of attendance. With this wording, they also want notice of absence. May I see the reply form?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。「欠席」に印を付けたいですが、それが今出している別の申請の取り下げまで意味するのかも心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 欠席欄を示し別申請の取下げまで意味するか心配と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. I want to mark absent, but I am also worried whether that means withdrawing another application I currently have pending.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point to the absent box and say in Japanese that you are worried whether it also means withdrawing a separate application.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 説明会の出欠と申請の扱いは分けて担当へ確認しましょう。欠席の返事で申請がどう扱われるかを、こちらで決めることはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check attendance at the session and the handling of the application separately with the person in charge. We cannot determine here how an absence response affects your application.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 欠席の返事だけをしたいです。申請を取り下げるつもりはないので、その意図を担当へ伝えてから書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 欠席連絡のみ希望し申請を取り下げる意図なしを担当へ伝えてから記入したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I only want to report that I will be absent. I do not intend to withdraw my application, so I want to tell the person in charge that intention before filling it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to fill in the form after telling the person in charge that you only want to report absence and do not intend to withdraw the application.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 意図を伝えます。返信期限と送付先は、この用紙の下にも案内があります。確認したい点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will convey your intention. The reply deadline and mailing destination are also explained at the bottom of this sheet. Is there anything you would like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 封筒の差出元と返信先が違う欄にあるので、どちらへ出すかを確かめたいです。期限の日付も、説明会当日と混ぜずに見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 差出元と返信先が違うため提出先と返信期限を説明会日と分けて確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: The sender on the envelope and the reply destination are in different fields, so I want to confirm where to send it. I will also read the deadline separately from the session date.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to distinguish the reply destination from the sender and confirm the submission destination and reply deadline separately from the session date.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 期限と提出先を担当に照会します。書き方の説明を受けたら、ご自身の出欠と用件に間違いがないか見直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will ask the person in charge about the deadline and submission destination. Once you have instructions on filling it in, please review whether your attendance choice and purpose are correct.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 欠席の返事と申請の扱い、返信先、期限を確認してから記入します。行けないから放置せず、まだ送ったことにもせず、提出方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 出欠と申請扱い返信先期限を聞いて記入し放置も提出済み扱いもせず提出方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will fill it in after checking the absence response, how my application is handled, the reply destination, and the deadline. I will not leave it unattended because I cannot go, or treat it as already sent; I will ask how to submit it.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check attendance, application handling, reply destination, and deadline before filling it in, neither ignore it nor regard it as submitted, and ask how to submit it.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では返信について担当へつなぎます。まだ申請の取下げや提出の完了ではありません。案内一式をお持ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will connect you to the person in charge about the reply. Neither withdrawal of the application nor submission is complete yet. Please bring all the information materials. Please excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 税の通知をご持参ですね。何と比べて気になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have brought a tax notice. What are you comparing it with that concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 給与から税が引かれているのに、別の通知が来ました。同じ税を二回払うのかと思いましたが、名前をまだきちんと読めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与天引きと別通知で二重払いか不安だが税名未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: Tax is deducted from my salary, but another notice arrived. I wondered if I have to pay the same tax twice, but have not properly read the name yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that payroll deductions and a separate notice make you worry about double payment, but you have not checked the tax name.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず税の名称と発行元を分けて確認しましょう。給与の書類にある欄も見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, let us check the tax's name and issuer separately. Could you also show me the relevant field on your salary document?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 給与明細はこちらです。似た文字だけ見て同じ税と思ったので、通知の税名と明細の欄名を並べて読んでほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 似た字だけで同税と思ったため通知名と給与欄名の照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is my payslip. I thought it was the same tax just from similar characters, so I would like you to read the tax name on the notice and the payslip field name side by side.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to compare the notice's tax name and payslip field name because you assumed the same tax from similar characters alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 名称の照合を担当へつなぎます。通知にある年度や、対象となる期間も、受け取った日とは別に確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will refer you to the person in charge to compare the names. The fiscal year and period covered on the notice must also be checked separately from the date you received it.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 届いたのは今月ですが、対象も今月分とは限らないのですね。年度と期間を確認し、勤務先のどの時期の書類が必要かも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受取月を対象月とせず年度期間と必要な勤務先書類の時期を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: It arrived this month, but that does not necessarily mean it covers this month. I want to check the fiscal year and period, and also ask which period's documents from work are needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not assume the received month is the covered month, and ask about the fiscal year, period, and dates of required workplace documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 資料の範囲を担当へ確認します。ここで二重請求や支払い不要と決める段階ではありません。支払いの相談も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check the scope of documents with the person in charge. We are not at a stage where we can decide here that it is a duplicate bill or that no payment is needed. Do you also need payment advice?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もし支払いが必要なら、一度に払うのが難しい事情があります。免除されると決めず、期限までに相談する担当と方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 支払必要なら一括困難で免除を決めつけず期限前の相談担当と方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: If payment is needed, my circumstances make paying all at once difficult. Without assuming an exemption, please tell me whom to consult before the deadline and how.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that if payment is required, paying all at once is difficult, and ask whom and how to consult before the deadline without assuming an exemption.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 支払い内容の確認と、事情を説明する相談先を分けてご案内します。資料は通知も給与の書類も残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will guide you separately on checking what payment concerns and where to explain your circumstances. Please retain both the notice and salary documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通知を誤りと決めて捨てず、両方持って相談します。税名、対象期間、必要資料と期限をメモし、勤務先へ確認すべき点も聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通知を誤りとして捨てず給与資料と持参し税名期間必要資料期限と会社への質問を控えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not decide that the notice is wrong and throw it away; I will bring both for consultation. I will note the tax name, covered period, required documents, and deadline, and also ask what I should check with work.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not discard the notice as mistaken, will bring it with payroll documents, and will note the tax name, period, required documents, deadline, and questions for work.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは名称と対象期間の確認から担当へご案内します。支払いの要否や猶予はまだ決まっていません。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will direct you to the person in charge, starting with the name and covered period. Whether payment is required or a deferral applies has not been decided yet. Please excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この写真のラーメンについて、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the ramen in this photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 上の赤い具が気になります。辛い物が苦手なので、これを抜けばスープまで辛くなくなるのか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 辛い物が苦手で赤い具を抜けばスープまで辛くなくなるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am concerned about the red topping. I am not good with spicy food, so I want to know whether removing it would make even the soup non-spicy.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether removing the red topping would make the soup non-spicy too, because you do not tolerate spicy food well.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この品は赤い具を別添えにできますが、スープ自体の味は変えられません。辛さの感じ方まで保証はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can serve the red topping separately for this item, but cannot change the soup's own flavor. We cannot guarantee how spicy it will feel to you.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 赤い具だけを外せば全部変わるとは思わないでおきます。スープの特徴を説明してもらってから、こちらを選ぶか決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 具除去で全味変更とせずスープ特徴説明後に選びたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will not assume that taking off just the red topping changes everything. I would like to hear an explanation of the soup's characteristics before deciding whether to choose this item.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not assume removing the topping changes all the flavors and want to choose after hearing the soup's characteristics.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この品のスープはしょうゆ味で、赤い具は辛みを加える別の具です。量については、通常より麺を少なくする相談もできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: This item's soup is soy-sauce flavored, and the red topping is a separate topping that adds heat. Regarding quantity, you can also discuss having fewer noodles than usual.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 麺は少なめを希望します。量が減れば価格も必ず下がるとは考えず、別添えと少なめでいくらになるか先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 麺少なめ希望だが自動値下げとせず別添え条件込み料金を先に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like fewer noodles. I will not assume that a smaller amount automatically means a lower price, so I want to ask first how much it costs with the topping separate and fewer noodles.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want fewer noodles but do not assume an automatic price reduction, and ask the price including separate-topping arrangements first.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この注文では、麺を少なくしても表示の料金は変わりません。赤い具の別添えにも追加はありません。内容を確認して決めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: For this order, the displayed price remains the same even with fewer noodles. There is also no extra charge to serve the red topping separately. Please check the details before deciding.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 料金が同じだと確認しました。説明を聞いたこの品を、麺少なめ、赤い具は別添えで一つお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同料金を確認し説明済み品を一つ麺少なめ赤具別添えで注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have confirmed the price is the same. Please give me one of the item you explained, with fewer noodles and the red topping separate.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese the same price and order one of the explained item with fewer noodles and the red topping separate.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一つ、麺少なめ、赤い具は別添えですね。飲み物もご一緒に注文なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: One, with fewer noodles and the red topping separate, correct? Would you also like to order a drink?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 飲み物は今は頼みません。料理一つだけで、スープの味を変える注文ではないことも合わせて確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 飲料は注文せず料理一つのみでスープ変更ではないと確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not order a drink now. Please also confirm that it is just one dish and that I am not ordering a change to the soup's flavor.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not order a drink, want just one dish, and ask to confirm this does not change the soup.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 料理一つ、麺少なめと赤い具別添えで承りました。スープは通常の味です。少々お待ちください。ご注文ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your order is one dish, with fewer noodles and the red topping separate. The soup will have its usual flavor. Please wait a moment. Thank you for your order.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 皆様で取り分けるお料理について、確認したいことがあるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to check something about a dish everyone will share, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私には卵のアレルギーがあります。友人たちがこの大皿を頼む予定ですが、私も卵が見えない部分だけ食べればよいとは考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 卵アレルギーがあり共有大皿の見えない部分だけ食べるつもりはないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have an egg allergy. My friends plan to order this large platter, but I am not assuming that I can eat just the parts where no egg is visible.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have an egg allergy and do not intend to eat only the parts of the shared platter where no egg is visible.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 料理全体の材料と調理について担当に確認します。大皿のほかに、別の料理をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the ingredients and preparation of the whole dish with the person in charge. Would you like another dish besides the large platter?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 別皿も候補にしたいですが、大皿と同じ器具を使うのかも確認してください。私の分は、答えが出る前に盛り付けないでほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別皿も検討するが共用器具を確認し回答前に本人分を盛らないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to consider a separate dish too, but please also check whether it uses the same utensils as the platter. I do not want my portion plated before there is an answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are considering a separate dish but want shared utensils checked and ask that your portion not be plated before the answer.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本人分の盛付けを止めて確認します。担当から、別皿でも調理時の共用について確認できない点があるとの回答です。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will stop plating your portion and check. The person in charge says that even for a separate dish, some points about shared equipment during preparation cannot be confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 別皿なら必ず条件が違うとは言えないのですね。確認できないまま私の料理を注文せず、友人にも私へ取り分けないよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別皿も不明点があるため注文せず友人にも本人へ取り分けないよう伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: So we cannot say that a separate dish necessarily has different conditions. I will not order my food while that is unconfirmed, and will tell my friends not to serve me from the platter either.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that because even a separate dish has unknowns, you will not order and will tell friends not to serve you a portion.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お客様の注文は保留にします。大皿を他の方が注文される場合も、お客様が食べるとこちらで判断はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will put your order on hold. Even if others order the platter, we will not assume that you will eat it.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私が食べないことと、友人たちの注文は分けてください。私の席に小皿があっても、料理を入れる合図とは受け取らないでほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人は食べず友人注文と分け席の小皿を盛付け同意としないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please keep the fact that I will not eat separate from my friends' orders. Even if there is a small plate at my seat, please do not take it as a signal to put food on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to keep your not eating separate from friends' orders and not treat a small plate at your seat as consent to serve you.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その点を配膳担当へ伝えます。現時点で確認できた材料と、器具の不明点も分けてご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will convey that to the serving staff. We will also explain separately the ingredients confirmed at this point and the unknown points about utensils.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明を聞き、今日は私の食事は見送ります。大皿から少し試すこともせず、本人分の注文が入っていないと最後に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本日は食事を見送り共有皿の試食もせず本人注文なしを最後に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: After hearing the explanation, I will forgo my meal today. I will not try even a little from the shared platter, and would like to confirm at the end that no order has been placed for me.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will forgo food today, not sample the shared platter, and want final confirmation that no personal order was placed.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お客様の食事は注文せず、取り分けもしないと担当へ共有します。ほかの皆様の注文とは分けて承ります。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will inform the staff that no meal is to be ordered or portioned out for you. We will handle that separately from everyone else's orders. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計の明細をお持ちしました。幹事の方がまとめて確認なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: I have brought the itemized bill. Will the organizer check it all together?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私が確認します。予約のときに預かり金を払っていますが、この明細ではその分が引かれているかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 幹事として予約預かり金が明細で差引済みか不明と尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will check it. We paid a deposit when booking, but I cannot tell from this bill whether that amount has been deducted.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese as the organizer whether the booking deposit has already been deducted from the itemized bill, since that is unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約の控えや、お支払いを確認できるものはありますか。記録と照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the booking confirmation or something that verifies the payment? We will compare it with the records.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この控えです。料理の合計が間違っていると言いたいのではなく、先に払った分と今日払う残額を分けて見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 控えを示し料理合計の誤りではなく先払と本日残額を分けて確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the confirmation. I am not saying the total for the food is wrong; I want to see the amount already paid separately from the balance due today.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the confirmation and say in Japanese that you want to distinguish the advance payment and today's balance, not claim an error in the food total.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記録を確認したところ、先のお預かり分がまだこの明細に反映されていません。差し引いた残額の明細を出し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: After checking the records, I found that the earlier deposit has not yet been reflected in this bill. We will issue a new bill showing the balance after deducting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 残額を出し直してもらえますか。参加者から集める額を決める前に、古い合計と新しい残額を取り違えないよう確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 残額明細を求め参加者徴収額決定前に旧合計と残額を区別すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: Could you issue the balance again? Before deciding how much to collect from participants, I will check to avoid confusing the old total with the new balance.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request the balance statement in Japanese and say you will distinguish the old total and remaining balance before deciding the amount to collect from participants.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらが修正した明細です。預かり分と残額の欄を分けました。お支払いの分け方にご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is the corrected bill. We have separate fields for the deposit and the balance. Do you have any preference about dividing payment?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 店では私が残額をまとめて払います。参加者同士の負担は後で話すので、お店に人数で割った別会計を頼むつもりではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 店では幹事が残額一括払いし参加者負担調整は別にして分割会計を求めないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will pay the remaining balance all together here. We will discuss participants' shares later, so I am not asking the restaurant for separate bills divided by the number of people.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the organizer will pay the balance all together at the restaurant, with participants' shares arranged separately, and is not requesting split bills.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 残額をまとめてのお支払いですね。明細を確認してから、お支払い方法をお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: You will pay the balance all together, then. Please check the details before choosing a payment method.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 預かり分が反映された残額を確認しました。カードでまとめて払います。修正明細と、支払い後の控えを受け取って保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 預かり反映残額を確認しカード一括払いと修正明細・決済後控えの保管を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the balance with the deposit reflected. I will pay all together by card. I will receive and keep the corrected bill and the payment confirmation after payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese the balance after the deposit and request a single card payment and retention of the corrected statement and post-payment confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では確認後の残額でカード会計に進みます。お支払いが済んだら控えをお渡しします。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will proceed with card payment for the confirmed remaining balance. We will give you the payment confirmation after payment is complete. Thank you very much.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 御朱印の受付について、ご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the reception for goshuin shrine or temple stamps?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私と連れがそれぞれ帳面を持っています。二冊を同じ袋に入れてしまったので、預ける前に自分のものを確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人と連れの御朱印帳が同じ袋で預ける前に自分のものを確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: My companion and I each have a stamp book. We put both in the same bag, so I want to check which is mine before handing it over.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your and your companion's goshuin books are in the same bag and you want to identify yours before leaving it at reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まずお二人で表紙などを確かめてください。こちらでは、見た目が似ているだけで持ち主を判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, please check the covers or other identifying features together. We cannot determine ownership simply because they look similar.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の帳面は、表紙の内側に名前を書いてあります。連れにも自分の分を確かめてもらい、一冊ずつ本人が受付へ出す形にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 内側名で本人帳面を確認し連れも確かめ一冊ずつ本人受付にすると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: My name is written inside the cover of my book. I will have my companion check theirs too, and each of us will submit our own book individually at reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will identify your book by the name inside, have your companion check theirs, and each owner will submit one book individually.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この窓口では、お預かり後に受付番号でお呼びする案内です。受け取るときに番号と帳面をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: At this desk, we call you by your reception number after taking the book. Please check the number and book when collecting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 預けた順だけで自分の番だと決めず、番号を見ます。二人の番号を同じだと思わず、それぞれの控えを持ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 預け順で判断せず各自番号と控えを区別して持ちたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will check the number rather than assume it is my turn just from the order we handed them in. I will not assume our numbers are the same; I want us each to keep our own slip.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not judge by submission order and want to distinguish each person's number and keep the slips separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 控えはそれぞれでお持ちください。受付の前を空けて待つ場所はこちらです。途中で離れる予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please each keep your own slip. Here is the waiting place that leaves the front of reception clear. Do you plan to leave the area in the meantime?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 遠くへは行かず、案内された場所で待ちます。連れの分も勝手に受け取らず、別の人が受け取る場合の扱いは先に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 指定場所で待ち連れ分も勝手に受取らず代理受取条件を先に聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: We will not go far and will wait in the place indicated. I will not collect my companion's book without permission, and will ask first about arrangements if someone else collects it.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait in the designated place, not collect your companion's book on your own, and ask in advance about collection by a representative.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受取の条件については、その時の担当へ確認してください。撮影は受付内でしないという表示もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the collection conditions with the person in charge at that time. Please also note the sign saying not to take photos inside reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受付では撮らず、自分の番号と帳面を照合して受け取ります。受け取ってから袋へまとめる前に、連れにも中身を確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付撮影せず本人番号帳面を照合し袋へまとめる前に連れにも確認を頼むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not take photos at reception and will match my number with my book when collecting it. After collection, before putting both in the bag, I will also have my companion check the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not photograph reception, will match your number and book, and ask your companion to check theirs before combining them in the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ではお一人ずつ受付で伺います。受付後は控えをお持ちのまま、案内された場所でお待ちください。ご参拝ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will assist each of you individually at reception. After registering, please keep your slip with you and wait in the place indicated. Thank you for your worship visit.
